title: ruthea interrupta
intro: Ruthea interrupta, commonly known as the interrupted Ruthea, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Ruthea interrupta include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and soothe digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Ruthea interrupta include limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
